title: Record that the flag-0 source read has no owner
body:
## Summary
- Event 5759 is `Y34 += -1/2 * X0` on the full frame. The add has five fields and no owner field.
- The tail package's result, task and readme state that no global owner or host is assigned for the appended source reads.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. This reading does not build a schedule.
